notes.title: Major Update 1.0.2!
notes.notes:
Hello Archers!
We have prepared a Major Update 1.0.2, check that you have Save 2020 actualized.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40011448/f255c4c698acaa5883f9afa8b88cd1b6ecfeafd2.png[/img]
